name: Buxenus

attributes.attribute: a Continental Celtic god of Gaulish origin
known only from a single inscription
described by the Romans as similar to their god Mars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Buxenus is a Continental Celtic god. This Gaulish divinity is known only from a single inscription. The occupying Romans described him as similar to their warrior god Mars. His worship left no wider record. He is one of many local Celtic gods the Romans equated with their own deities.

okr.objective: Describe Buxenus as a Continental Celtic god known from one inscription.
key_results: Buxenus was a Gaulish divinity of the Continental Celts.
He is known only from a single inscription.
The Romans described him as similar to their warrior god Mars.
